column1: # Chinese grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# Words are written traditional first, then their simplified spelling after
# a `/` (還/还): both are the word's lemma, and the headword shows the one the
# text uses first. A line comes before Wiktionary's entries for the word,
# which are mostly a character's whole page, in Wiktionary's order (的 opens
# on "bright; clear"); content words stay after it.
# Lines are for a word's common grammatical uses, which a character's page
# lists late or not at all. See apps/importer/src/grammar.ts.
# Each sense explains what the word does, for a learner reading it next to
# the sentence: what it expresses, then the English, then a short phrase in
# brackets when the English alone doesn't settle it ("not until, later than
# expected: he didn't come until ten (他十點才來)"). No notes on position:

column3: links a describing word or phrase to the noun after it: of, 's: my book (我的書), red flowers (紅色的花) | stands for a noun left out: the one that: the new one (新的), someone who sells vegetables (賣菜的) | at the end of a sentence, stresses that something is so: I will go, for sure (我會去的) | 是…的: stresses when, where or how it happened: it was yesterday that he came (他是昨天來的)
after a verb, the action is done: I ate (我吃了飯) | at the end of a sentence, something has changed or is now so: it's raining now (下雨了), I get it now (我懂了) | 太…了: too, so: great! (太好了)
an action or state goes on: -ing: he said, smiling (他笑著說), the door is open (門開著)
after a verb, it has happened at least once: have ever done: I have been to Beijing (我去過北京)
makes an adverb of the word before it: -ly: walk slowly (慢慢地走)
after a verb or adjective, says how or how much: he runs fast (他跑得很快), so tired he doesn't want to move (累得不想動) | between a verb and its result, can: can see (看得見), can understand (聽得懂)
turns a statement into a yes-or-no question: are you a student? (你是學生嗎?)
and you?, what about ...?: I'm fine, and you? (我很好, 你呢?) | softens a question: what are you doing? (你在做什麼呢?) | an action still going on: he's sleeping (他在睡覺呢)
suggests or asks softly: let's: let's go (我們走吧) | a guess, checking: right?: you're a teacher, right? (你是老師吧?)
啊 after a vowel: softens or stresses what is said: OK! (好呀), come on! (快來呀) → 啊 | after each item of a list, in speech
at the end of a sentence, softens or stresses it: ah, oh: OK! (好啊), so beautiful! (真漂亮啊) | a pause in speech, or after each item of a list: as for this, I don't know either (這個啊, 我也不知道)
stresses what should be obvious: after all, you know: that's how it should be, after all (這是應該的嘛) | a pause before what follows
makes people and pronouns plural: we (我們), friends (朋友們)

still, yet: he's still asleep (他還在睡), not yet (還沒) | also, in addition: I'd also like some tea (我還想喝茶) | even more, comparing: today is even colder than yesterday (今天比昨天還冷) | fairly, passably: not bad (還不錯)
right away, as soon as: I'll come right away (我馬上就來) | just, exactly: it's him (就是他), right here (就在這裡) | only, just: just one (就一個) | then, in that case: if you go, I'll go (要是你去, 我就去)
not until, later than expected: he didn't come until ten (他十點才來) | only, less than expected: only five yuan (才五塊錢) | only just: I've only just found out (我才知道)
all, both, everyone named before it: we are all students (我們都是學生) | already: it's already ten o'clock (都十點了) | even: even he knows (連他都知道)
also, too: I'm going too (我也去) | with 不 or 沒, not at all, not even: not tired at all (一點也不累)
again, of something that already happened: he came again (他又來了) | 又…又…: both ... and ...: both cheap and good (又便宜又好)
again, in the future: say it again (再說一遍), goodbye (再見) | then, after that: leave after eating (吃完飯再走)
very, quite; also just links an adjective to its subject: he is tall (他很高)
too: too expensive (太貴了) | so, very: great! (太好了)
most, -est: best (最好)
more, even more: better (更好), what's more important (更重要的是)
already: he has already left (他已經走了)
right now, in the middle of: -ing: I'm eating (我正在吃飯)
an action going on: -ing: he is reading (他在看書)
not, no: is not (不是), not good (不好) | 不…不…: neither ... nor; 不得不: have to
not, of what didn't happen or isn't there: I didn't go (我沒去), haven't eaten yet (還沒吃)
don't: don't worry (別擔心)
together: let's go together (我們一起去吧)
all along, the whole time: he has been waiting all along (他一直在等) | straight on: go straight ahead (一直走)
only, just: I only have one (我只有一個)
越…越…: the more ... the more ...: better and better (越來越好), the faster the better (越快越好)
in, inside: in the room (房間裡), in one's heart (心裡)
in, among, during: in life (生活中), among the students (學生中)
on, above: on the table (桌子上) | in, in terms of: online (網上), in history (歷史上)
under, below: under the table (桌子下) | 在…下: under, with: with his help (在他的幫助下)
inside, within: within the country (國內), within three days (三天內)
outside, beyond: abroad (國外), outside the door (門外) | 以外, 之外: besides, other than
at, in, on: where something is or happens: at home (在家), in China (在中國)
puts the object before the verb, to say what is done to it: close the door (把門關上), give me the book (把書給我)
by: makes the verb passive, often for something unwelcome: he was criticised by the teacher (他被老師批評了)
to, for: call him (給他打電話), show you (給你看)
to, towards, about: kind to me (對我很好), about this question (對這個問題)
with: go with friends (跟朋友去) | 跟…一樣: the same as | and: you and I (我跟你)
and, between nouns: you and I (我和你)
(formal) and, with: teachers and students (老師與學生)
from: come from Beijing (從北京來), starting today (從今天開始)
towards, to: walk east (向東走), learn from him (向他學習)
towards, in a direction: walk forward (往前走), to the left (往左)
for, for the sake of: happy for you (為你高興) | 為了: in order to
with, by means of, as: mainly ... (以…為主), before (以前), after (以後) | (formal) in order to
(formal) at, in, on: located in Beijing (位於北京) | than, to, after an adjective or verb: greater than (大於), belong to (屬於)
(formal) puts the object before the verb, as 把 does: bring the water to the boil (將水燒開) → 把
(formal) will, going to: the meeting will be held tomorrow (會議將在明天舉行)
than, comparing: he is taller than me (他比我高)
(formal) and, and also, joining verbs or clauses: discussed and passed (討論並通過)
並不, 並沒有: not at all, actually not, against what one might think: not hard at all (並不難)
(formal) and, but, while, joining two clauses or words: fast and good (快而好) | 不是…而是…: not ... but ...
but: good, but too expensive (很好, 但是太貴)
but: I want to go, but I have no time (我想去, 可是沒時間)
so, therefore: it rained, so I didn't go (下雨了, 所以我沒去)
because: because it rained, I didn't go (因為下雨, 我沒去)
if: if you have time (如果你有時間)
although; often followed by 但是 in the next part: though tired, happy (雖然很累, 但是很高興) → 但是
or, in statements: tea or coffee (茶或者咖啡); questions use 還是 → 還是
or, in questions: tea or coffee? (你喝茶還是咖啡?); statements use 或者 → 或者
still, all the same: he came all the same (他還是來了) | had better: you'd better go (你還是去吧)
if, closing an if-clause: if it rains, I won't go (下雨的話, 我就不去)
links a subject to what it is: am, is, are: I am a student (我是學生); an adjective takes 很 instead → 很 | yes, right | 是…的: stresses when, where or how it happened
can, a learned skill: I can swim (我會游泳) | will, likely to: it will rain tomorrow (明天會下雨)
can, able to: I can come (我能來) | may, allowed to
can, may, permission: may I come in? (我可以進來嗎?) | not bad, OK: so-so (還可以)
want to: I want to go home (我要回家) | will, going to: it's going to rain (要下雨了) | must, should: you must be careful (你要小心)
would like to, want to, softer than 要: I'd like some water (我想喝水) → 要
should, ought to: you should rest (你應該休息)
děi: must, have to: I have to go (我得走了)
to have: I have a question (我有一個問題) | there is, there are: there are many people here (這裡有很多人)
to let, to make someone do something: let me think (讓我想想), make him happy (讓他高興)
this, near you: this is mine (這是我的), this one (這個), here (這裡)
that, further away: what is that? (那是什麼?), that one (那個), there (那裡)
then, in that case: then let's go (那我們走吧)
which: which one? (哪個?), where (哪裡)
what: what did you say? (你說什麼?) | any, anything: it's nothing (沒什麼) | things like, before a list, in speech: there's coffee, tea, all sorts (什麼咖啡、茶都有)
how: how do I get there? (怎麼走?) | why, how come, often surprised: why aren't you coming? (你怎麼不來?)
how, how about it: what do you think? (你覺得怎麼樣?), how have you been? (最近怎麼樣?)
why: why are you crying? (你為什麼哭?)
oneself, one's own: I'll do it myself (我自己做), one's own room (自己的房間)
the counting word for most nouns, and for those without one of their own: one person (一個人), three apples (三個蘋果)
some, a few: some (一些), these (這些), those (那些)
kind, type: this kind of book (這種書), all kinds of (各種)
time, occurrence: once (一次), the first time (第一次)
the counting word for shops, companies and families: a restaurant (一家餐廳)
makes an ordinal number: -th: first (第一), the third day (第三天)
very, extremely: very good (非常好), thank you very much (非常感謝)
especially, particularly: especially (特別是)
of course: of course you can (當然可以)
but, however, softer than 但是: but I have no time (不過我沒時間) → 但是 | only, merely: only, just (不過是)
anyway, whatever happens: I'm not going anyway (反正我不去)
about, roughly, after a number: about three minutes (三分鐘左右)
then, next: then add salt (接著放鹽)
besides, apart from: except for ... (除了…以外), outside China (中國以外)
respectively, each separately: are respectively (分別是)
probably: he probably isn't coming (他大概不來了) | about, roughly: about ten people (大概十個人)
really, truly: really good (真的很好), really? (真的嗎?)
someone, some people: some people say (有人說)
and so on, etc., after a list: books, pens, etc. (書、筆等) | and others, after names
Taiwan: short for 臺灣: come to Taiwan (來臺) → 臺灣
mm, uh-huh: agreeing, listening or thinking | mm: enjoying something
uh, er: a pause while thinking | hey: getting someone's attention
that is to say, in other words
that is to say, in other words
hard to, not easy to, before a verb: hard to say (不好說) | not good
in fact, actually
a moment, a little, after a verb; softens a request: have a look (看一下), wait a moment (等一下)
